newsitem.title: USA: Angelica sets health-care textiles pact.
newsitem.headline: Angelica sets health-care textiles pact.

text.p: Angelica Corp said on Tuesday it has formed an alliance with Standard Textile Co to contract with Premier Purchasing Partners to supply health-care textiles to Premier's 1,800 hospital and health care affiliates.

Under the five-year agreement, Angelica and Standard Textile, based in Cincinnati, will be preferred suppliers of textile laundry services and linen management programs designed to lower textile processing costs, as well as health care garments and uniforms to Premier Purchasing Partners.
Angelica did not disclose specific terms of the arrangement.
Premier Purchasing Partners, based in Westchester, Ill, is an affiliate of Premier Inc, a large U.S. health care alliance.
Shares of Angelica on Tuesday traded down 1/8, at 19. --Chicago Newsdesk (312)408-8787
